title: Agent i2v from an open image card lands the video in that card's history, where it cannot be seen
description: Fabio 2026-10-21, project Flux 3 tests: Cosmo ran Seedance 2.0 i2v on i2i_001 while the image card was open; i2v_003.mp4 landed as an entry of the IMAGE card. workspaceGenerationOpts lets the OPEN card keep any output type (MPI-890 rule); only a not-open card is type-checked (MPI-891). A history workspace is typed: the user's prompt box there only runs that card's media type, so a clip from a still must be a new gallery card. Fix: the open card and a masked card must hold the output's media type too. One fix covers cloud and local (agentDispatch picks the landing before enqueueGeneration).
